name: title
label: Question
help: What needs a decision, as a short question (at most 200 characters), such as Refund order #1042 for $89?

name: options
label: Choices
help: 2 to 4 choices. The first one approves; any other rejects. Leave empty for Approve and Reject.

name: details
label: Details
help: Context shown to the person: what will happen and why (at most 4000 characters).

name: expires
label: Expires in (minutes)
help: How long the link can be answered: 1 to 10080 (7 days). Default 60.

name: channel
label: Channel
help: Optional channel to announce the request and its answer on, for the @hibira-io/approvals inbox, such as private-hibira-approvals.ops.

name: pushTarget
label: Push the link to
help: Optionally send the link as a push notification. The app needs Push turned on.
